description: Image Description: The image displays a collection of plush teddy bears arranged closely together, likely on display for sale. The teddy bears are uniformly light brown in color and appear to be made of soft, fuzzy fabric. Each bear is adorned with a red and green plaid scarf tied around its neck, adding a festive or seasonal touch. The bears have black button eyes and stitched noses, giving them a classic, traditional appearance. Several price tags are visible, attached to the bears with yellow strings;
